selection.ownership: Tapfiliate is an Amsterdam-based affiliate tracking SaaS; REST API at api.tapfiliate.com. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Tapfiliate REST API 1.6 (X-Api-Key, https://api.tapfiliate.com/1.6, GET /programs/ /affiliates/ /affiliates/{id}/ /commissions/, 1-based page, Link header pagination, rate-limit headers), Amsterdam company identity, and dated incident search (Tapfiliate + security breach/incident). No qualifying current unresolved Tapfiliate customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.
Official Tapfiliate REST API 1.6, Amsterdam identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. This is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

commissions.list.title: List commissions
commissions.list.description: List Tapfiliate commissions with optional page, status, affiliate, program, conversion, and date filters.

page.description: 1-based page number. Omit to request the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page when the API accepts it.

conversion_id.description: Only return commissions for this conversion.

created_at_from.description: Include commissions created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Include commissions created at or before this timestamp.

paid.description: When true, only include paid commissions.

conversions.list.title: List conversions
conversions.list.description: List conversions with optional program, affiliate, external id, pending, and date filters.

page.description: 1-based page number. Omit to request the first page.

pending.description: Only include conversions with pending commissions.

date_from.description: Filter conversions from this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

date_to.description: Filter conversions up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

use_profile_timezone.description: Use the Tapfiliate profile timezone for date filters.

customers.list.title: List customers
customers.list.description: List customers with optional program, customer, affiliate, and date filters.

page.description: 1-based page number. Omit to request the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page when the API accepts it.

balances.list.title: List balances
balances.list.description: List outstanding non-zero affiliate balances. Officially non-paginated; page is accepted when provided.

page.description: 1-based page number. Omit to request the first page.

payments.list.title: List payments
payments.list.description: List Tapfiliate payments with optional pagination.

page.description: 1-based page number. Omit to request the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page when the API accepts it.

payments.create.title: Create payment
payments.create.description: Create a payment that credits an affiliate balance.

amount.description: Payment amount. Must be greater than 0.

payments.cancel.title: Cancel payment
payments.cancel.description: Cancel a pending payment and return the amount to the affiliate balance.
